sections.theory:
18. Write the solution of the problems of the industrial sector.

A. (a) encouragement of the private sector; (b) foreign investment; (c) concessions in taxes; (d) availability of modern machinery.

Section II (Section II)

Question 2: Write detailed answers to the following questions.

(i) State the causes of the standard of living being low in Pakistan. (Lahore Board 2009)

(ii) Write the causes of the low per capita income in Pakistan. (Multan Board 2009, Lahore Board 2010)

(iii) Write the reasons for Pakistan’s per capita income being low. (Multan Board 2011)

(iv) How can an increase be made in the national income of Pakistan?

(v) Which factors are necessary for economic development?

(vi) State the big problems of the industrial sector of Pakistan.

(vii) State the importance and benefits of economic planning. (Lahore Board 2009, Gujranwala Board 2009)

(viii) What are the important objectives of economic planning in Pakistan?

Objective (Objective)

Question 3: More than one answer has been given for each question; of them put the mark (✓) on the correct answer.

1. Problems like national income are studied in this branch of economics:

(a) micro  (b) fiscal

(c) macro ✓  (d) mathematical

2. For measuring the national income of Pakistan this method is used:

(a) method of production  (b) method of total expenditure

(c) method of the sum of incomes of factors  (d) all three above ✓

3. Pakistan is basically such a country:

(a) industrial  (b) commercial

(c) agricultural ✓  (d) developed

4. In Pakistan’s real gross domestic product (GDP) the share of this sector is greater:

(a) trade  (b) agriculture ✓

(c) industry  (d) communications

5. This is a cottage industry:

(a) ghee industry  (b) steel mill

(c) sports goods ✓  (d) textile industry

6. The better and comprehensive definition of economic development was presented by:

(a) Kindleberger  (b) Arthur Lewis

(c) Meier and Baldwin ✓  (d) Professor Snider

حصہ دوم (Section II)

(viii) پاکستان میں معاشی منصوبہ بندی کے اہم مقاصد کیا ہوتے ہیں؟

معروضی (Objective)

1. قومی آمدنی جیسے مسائل کا مطالعہ معاشیات کی اس برانچ میں کیا جاتا ہے۔

(a) جزوی  (b) مالیاتی

(c) کلیاتی ✓  (d) ریاضیاتی

(c) عاملین کی آمدنیوں کے مجموعہ کا طریقہ  (d) درج بالا تینوں ✓

3. پاکستان بنیادی طور پر ایسا ملک ہے۔

(a) صنعتی  (b) تجارتی

(c) زرعی ✓  (d) ترقی یافتہ

(a) تجارت  (b) زراعت ✓

(c) صنعت  (d) مواصلات

5. یہ گھریلو صنعت ہے۔

(a) گھی کی صنعت  (b) سٹیل مل

(c) کھیلوں کا سامان ✓  (d) ٹیکسٹائل انڈسٹری

18. Write the solution of the problems of the industrial sector.

A. (a) encouragement of the private sector; (b) foreign investment; (c) concessions in taxes; (d) availability of modern machinery.

Section II (Section II)

Question 2: Write detailed answers to the following questions.

(i) State the causes of the standard of living being low in Pakistan. (Lahore Board 2009)

(ii) Write the causes of the low per capita income in Pakistan. (Multan Board 2009, Lahore Board 2010)

(iii) Write the reasons for Pakistan’s per capita income being low. (Multan Board 2011)

(iv) How can an increase be made in the national income of Pakistan?

(v) Which factors are necessary for economic development?

(vi) State the big problems of the industrial sector of Pakistan.

(vii) State the importance and benefits of economic planning. (Lahore Board 2009, Gujranwala Board 2009)

(viii) What are the important objectives of economic planning in Pakistan?

Objective (Objective)

Question 3: More than one answer has been given for each question; of them put the mark (✓) on the correct answer.

1. Problems like national income are studied in this branch of economics:

(a) micro  (b) fiscal

(c) macro ✓  (d) mathematical

2. For measuring the national income of Pakistan this method is used:

(a) method of production  (b) method of total expenditure

(c) method of the sum of incomes of factors  (d) all three above ✓

3. Pakistan is basically such a country:

(a) industrial  (b) commercial

(c) agricultural ✓  (d) developed

4. In Pakistan’s real gross domestic product (GDP) the share of this sector is greater:

(a) trade  (b) agriculture ✓

(c) industry  (d) communications

5. This is a cottage industry:

(a) ghee industry  (b) steel mill

(c) sports goods ✓  (d) textile industry

6. The better and comprehensive definition of economic development was presented by:

(a) Kindleberger  (b) Arthur Lewis

(c) Meier and Baldwin ✓  (d) Professor Snider
